modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: Carry-on that exceeds the limits at the boarding gate is offloaded and sent as checked baggage on the next available flight.

carryon_weight.value: 7kg on all fares, on all regional services operated by SAAB 340 Turboprop.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: Total linear dimensions must not exceed 105cm; on regional flights a bag must not exceed depth 23cm (9in), height 34cm (13in), length 48cm (19in).

personal_item.value: Where Rex has permitted a personal item (such as a handbag, purse or small backpack, a laptop, an overcoat or an umbrella), it counts within the 7 kg carry-on allowance and its dimensions.

modules.title: Checked baggage

allowance.value: All regional services operated by SAAB 340 Turboprop: Community, Promo and Saver fares 15kg; Flex 23kg.

excess.value: Excess baggage at the airport: $5.50 (incl. GST) for each additional kilogram. Additional Baggage bought at booking: $20 per 5kg (non-refundable).

oversize.value: $16.50 (incl. GST) per piece if h + w + d exceeds 140cm. Maximum 32kg per piece at the airport (heavier items go as air freight), and maximum length 2 metres.

rex_flyer.value: Rex Flyer Diamond members get 23kg on all fare classes; Opal, Sapphire and Emerald members get 15kg, or 23kg on Economy Flex.

infant.value: Lap infants (under 2): 2 pieces with a total combined weight of up to 10kg, which can include a pram/stroller, portable cot, baby capsule or car seat.

modules.lede: Rex connecting passengers on one booking get the higher of the two checked allowances.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled

refund.value: If Rex changes your flight schedule or cancels your flight, you may cancel the ticket and get a full refund, requested through the Rex Feedback Form or by calling 13 17 13.

modules.lede: Rex's conditions of carriage state that departure and arrival times are not guaranteed and that it is not responsible for accommodation arrangements or payments.

airport_cutoff.value: Be checked in and ready for boarding not less than 30 minutes before scheduled departure on all regional flights, except Burketown where it is 60 minutes. Missing it makes you a 'no show' and the booking is cancelled.

fare_name.value: Standard / Economy Light: includes 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item; checked bag allowance depends on route and fare category

seat_selection_included.value: Free seat assignment provided during online check-in; advance seat selection prior to check-in is available for a fee

change_cancellation_policy.value: Ticket modifications and cancellations are subject to carrier fare rules, change fees, and applicable fare difference

modules.title: Cabins and seating
modules.lede: Choose a seat by location and legroom, or accept a free seat assignment at check-in. Use your flight seat map because options vary with the aircraft.

seat_options.value: Standard seats, preferred location seats, and extra legroom seating options are available depending on aircraft and cabin class

reserved_or_random.value: Reserve a specific seat in advance for a fee or free depending on fare class, or receive a free seat assignment during online check-in

family_seating.value: Children traveling with an accompanying adult are seated together during advance seat reservation or at check-in
